name: JP Foliaki
bio: John-Paul "JP" Foliaki is a New Zealand-born Tongan actor, singer, and television presenter. He is widely recognised for his vibrant media presence, his soulful R&B/pop music, and for winning the 2024 season of Celebrity Treasure Island alongside Christian Cullen, Duncan Garner, and Gaby Solomona.

credits.title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
credits.overview: Follows Lisa, a successful designer returning for a school reunion, exploring themes of identity, family acceptance, romance with a rugby player, and personal growth within a Tongan-New Zealand community.

credits.title: Inky Pinky Ponky
credits.overview: When a young fakaleiti falls in love at St Valentine’s Highschool, she must navigate her way through a world of intolerance and bigotry to find happiness - in an unexpected place.

credits.title: Red, White & Brass
credits.overview: Maka, a Tongan superfan, will do whatever it takes to get tickets to the Tonga v France Rugby World Cup game - even if that means promising to deliver a brass band for the pre-match entertainment. Only problem is, the band doesn't exist and Maka has four weeks to make one. Inspired by a true story.
